# dsh-session-mode-indicator
Left-sidebar indicator for the mode (agent preset) each Session runs under.
简体中文 | **English**

Each Session keeps the mode it started with, and that mode cannot change once
the Session opens. The

plugin adds one piece of row metadata to the sidebar:
a small pill with a colored dot and the mode'

s name. The dot color identifies
the mode.
## Installation

Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` or newer. The plugin installs into one
profile, so every sess
ion opened from that profile loads it.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The CLI needs Node.js 24.9+ and `pnpm` on `PATH`; the desktop app ships its own
`dsh` command (add i

ts `resources\runtime\cli\bin` folder to `PATH`). `web` above
is only a profile name — use the one y
ou launch, then start the UI with `dsh web`.

In the desktop app you can also install it from the **Add plugin** wizard by
searching for `dsh-sess

ion-mode-indicator`, or ask the agent to call
`plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`.
There is no build step: the package is plain ESM JavaScript.

Verify: each Session row gets a mode pill, and **Settings → Mode dots** lists the
built-in modes.
## Modes are discovered, not hard-coded

- The four shipped presets — standard, PTC, create (cordis), minimal — carry
localized names and def

ault colors.
- Every other preset is a custom mode. A custom mode is listed and colored
only while i

t is still a declaration in the current profile or is used by a
live Session that is neither archive

d nor blank; retired presets and
archived-only or blank test modes stop being listed, and their pinn

ed color
is dropped so it no longer reserves a hue.
- When a custom mode is first seen it gets a col

or automatically: a
deterministic FNV-1a hash of its id seeds a vivid palette, probing past
colors a

lready in use so two modes rarely share one. The result is pinned in
browser storage, so a mode keep

s its color across restarts.
- Custom modes show their published preset name when they have one; oth

erwise
they render as the generic "Custom" label (the color still identifies them).
Nothing has to be edited in this package when a new mode appears.
## Settings
Settings → **Mode dots** (right after Agent presets) contains:

- **Show mode dots** — toggles the dot in the sidebar pill.
- **Built-in modes / Custom modes** — on

e row per known mode with a color
preview, ten preset swatches, and a native color picker; custom ro

ws also
show the full preset id.
- **Refresh** — re-reads the preset roster, picking up presets inst

alled since
the page was opened.
- **Reset colors** — drops user colors and re-derives the automatic

since
the page was opened.
- **Reset colors** — drops user colors and re-derives the automatic ones.

The preference lives in this Web client's `localStorage`
(`dsh.session-mode-indicator.settings.v1`,

shape version 2; the pre-v2
`colors` shape is migrated on read).
## Interface for future modes

The plugin provides the Client service `sessionModeIndicator`. A plugin that
knows a mode's display

name or wants to reserve its color registers it ahead
of time:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`registerMode` returns a disposer; retire the contribution by calling it or by
registering inside `c

tx.effect`. The service also exposes `getModes()` (the
current `{ id, name, color, builtin, contribu

ted }` list) and `subscribe(fn)`
for consumers that follow changes. Contributions live only while th

eir plugin
is loaded; auto-assigned colors keep working without any contributor.
## Files

- `client.js` — the whole UI: sidebar pill, settings section, color model,
public service.
- `index.

js` / `cordis.patch.yml` — the Host row and its bundle patch.
- `locale/*.json` — Plugin Manager tit

le/description.
- `docs/mode-badge-preview.png` — sidebar preview.
- `docs/settings-preview.png` — s
ettings page preview.
